
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/DolphinDB/p/22870486" title="发布于 2026-09-07 10:50">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DolphinDB 官方 Skill 全家桶：23 个技能覆盖你 80% 的日常需求</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        DolphinDB 官方准备了一批 Skill（技能）。你可以把它们想象成一群各有所长的 AI 小助手：有的专写 SQL，有的专导数据，有的专算因子。你在对话框里用大白话提需求，对应的小助手就自动接手，写好代码、直接在平台上跑通给你看。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p id="w-e-element-0" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-1" data-slate-node="text">第一次用 DolphinDB 写脚本的人，多半经历过这种时刻：思路明明很清楚，把某只股票的日 K 线读出来、算个 20 日均线，都不在话下；可真写起来，建表语法、<span id="w-e-text-2" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code>loadTable</code><span id="w-e-text-3" data-slate-node="text"> 参数、时间格式……随便记岔一个，脚本就报错，查文档又是一下午。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-4" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-5" data-slate-node="text">为了少让你吃这些苦，DolphinDB 官方准备了一批 <span id="w-e-text-6" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold">Skill（技能）</strong><span id="w-e-text-7" data-slate-node="text">。你可以把它们想象成一群各有所长的 AI 小助手：有的专写 SQL，有的专导数据，有的专算因子。你在对话框里用大白话提需求，对应的小助手就自动接手，写好代码、直接在平台上跑通给你看。这篇文章就是带你逐个认识官方内置的 23 个 Skill，看看每个是干什么的、能帮你省下什么功夫、什么时候该找它。不用硬记名字，下面先给你一张速查表：想做什么，直接对号入座。</span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-8" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-void="true">
<div class="w-e-textarea-divider"><hr></div>
<div data-slate-spacer="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p id="w-e-element-115" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-116" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">下面按"写代码 → 进数据 → 算东西 → 做展示与维护"的顺序逐个讲。</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-117" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-void="true">

<h2 id="w-e-element-119" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-120" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">一、写代码：AI 帮你写、改、优化 DolphinDB 脚本</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-121" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-122" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这组技能解决同一个问题：<span id="w-e-text-123" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">让 AI 写出"真能跑"的 DolphinDB 代码</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-124" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。它们按四种编程场景分工，写作时 AI 会按需挑选。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-125" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-126" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">1. dolphindb-basic-syntax-programming：基础语法（新手第一个用它）</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-127" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-128" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-129" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 教 AI 正确书写 DolphinDB / DolphinScript 基础语法的规则包，也是生成任何代码前默认先加载的"基础层"。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-130" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-131" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-132" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你用大白话说需求，它负责生成<span id="w-e-text-133" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">语法正确、结构完整、可直接运行</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-134" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">的第一版脚本；代码报错时，它还能帮你修语法错误。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-135" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-136" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-137" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 刚上手时几乎所有需求都会触发它。建表、读写数据、写一段计算逻辑、排查 <span id="w-e-text-138" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">loadTable</span></code><span id="w-e-text-139" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 用错了、搞不清字符串和时间的写法……这些事都要先经过它。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-140" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-141" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">2. dolphindb-sql-programming：SQL 编写与优化</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-142" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-143" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-144" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 专门管 DolphinDB SQL 的规则包。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-145" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-146" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-147" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> DolphinDB 的 SQL 和标准 SQL 有不少差异（<span id="w-e-text-148" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">context by</span></code><span id="w-e-text-149" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、<span id="w-e-text-150" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">cgroup by</span></code><span id="w-e-text-151" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、<span id="w-e-text-152" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">aj/wj/pwj</span></code><span id="w-e-text-153" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 等特有写法）。这款技能保证 AI 写出的查询<span id="w-e-text-154" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">语义正确、能走分区剪枝、不会慢</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-155" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，并会审查、优化你已有的 SQL。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-156" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-157" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-158" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 涉及查询、分组、窗口、表关联、分布式表查询时。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-159" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-160" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">3. dolphindb-vectorization-programming：性能优化</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-161" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-162" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-163" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 教 AI 用<span id="w-e-text-164" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">向量化思维</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-165" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">写代码的技能。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-166" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-167" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-168" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> DolphinDB 的核心理念是"一次处理一列，而不是一行一行循环"。当你发现脚本跑得慢、写了一堆 <span id="w-e-text-169" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">for</span></code><span id="w-e-text-170" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 循环时，它会把逐元素处理改写成批量计算、SQL 或合适的执行方式，<span id="w-e-text-171" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">性能往往提升几个数量级</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-172" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-173" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-174" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-175" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 代码能跑但很慢、循环太多、处理大数据量时。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-176" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-177" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">4. dolphindb-functional-programming：函数式编程</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-178" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-179" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-180" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 覆盖高阶函数、函数模式、lambda、部分应用、模块与函数视图等<span id="w-e-text-181" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">函数式写法</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-182" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">的规则包。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-183" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-184" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-185" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 让 AI 用更简洁、无副作用的函数组合替代冗长写法，处理"函数作用在数据上/函数上/函数集合上"三类场景。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-186" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-187" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-188" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你需要用 <span id="w-e-text-189" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">each</span></code><span id="w-e-text-190" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、<span id="w-e-text-191" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">reduce</span></code><span id="w-e-text-192" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、<span id="w-e-text-193" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">groupby</span></code><span id="w-e-text-194" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 这类高阶入口组织代码，或把复杂嵌套调用改写得更清晰时。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<blockquote id="w-e-element-195" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-196" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">新手提示： 如果你刚开始，把第 1 款用好就够了；第 2-4 款是 AI 在遇到对应场景时自动启用的"进阶外挂"，你不用记，知道有它们即可。</span></span></span></blockquote>
<div id="w-e-element-197" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-void="true">
<div class="w-e-textarea-divider"><hr></div>
<div data-slate-spacer="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<h2 id="w-e-element-199" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-200" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">二、进数据：把数据弄进 DolphinDB</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-201" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-202" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">数据进库是几乎所有项目的第一步。官方按数据来源拆成了 5 组技能，特点都是<span id="w-e-text-203" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">全自动流程</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-204" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">：你填参数，AI 在 Web 端把脚本跑完。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-205" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-206" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">1. dolphindb-data-import：通用数据导入向导</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-207" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-208" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-209" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 一张"导入方法决策树"，覆盖 CSV/TXT、JSON、二进制、Parquet、HDF5，以及 MySQL、ODBC 等外部库，还有 MQTT、OPC UA 等 IoT 实时接入。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-210" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-211" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-212" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你只要说"把这个 CSV 导进分区表"，它自动判断该用 <span id="w-e-text-213" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">loadTextEx</span></code><span id="w-e-text-214" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 还是分块导入（大文件防内存爆掉）、要不要插件、时间列怎么处理，<span id="w-e-text-215" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">避免新手最常见的 OOM 和乱码坑</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-216" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-217" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-218" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">2. dolphindb-finance-dbtbcreate + dolphindb-finance-dataimport：金融 CSV"建库 + 导数"两步走</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-219" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-220" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这对技能专为"手头有一批金融 CSV"设计，拆成两步，职责清晰：</span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-221" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-222" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">finance-dbtbcreate（先建库建表）：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-223" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 自动识别 CSV 的列和类型、算好分区方案（股票按天+HASH、日K按年分区等），帮你把库表建好；</span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-224" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-225" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">finance-dataimport（再导数据）：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-226" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 把 CSV 导进<span id="w-e-text-227" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">已存在</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-228" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">的表，导入前会做 schema 兼容检查，列顺序对不上会先问你，绝不悄悄覆盖。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-229" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-230" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-231" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 拿到 Level-2 快照、逐笔、日K/分钟K 等标准数据集时，直接报数据集类型即可。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-232" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-233" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">3. dolphindb-tushare-check-env + dolphindb-tushare-import：Tushare 数据导入</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-234" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-235" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Tushare 是国内常用的金融数据接口。这对技能一个管"检查环境"（<span id="w-e-text-236" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">httpClient</span></code><span id="w-e-text-237" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 插件、<span id="w-e-text-238" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">easy_tushare</span></code><span id="w-e-text-239" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 模块是否就绪，缺了自动装），一个管"真正导入"。主技能支持 <span id="w-e-text-240" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">stock、index、fund、bond、futures、options、etf、spot、fx、llm 十个数据域</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-241" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-242" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-243" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-244" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 填上 token 和日期范围，股票日线、财报、期货合约……自动建表 + 拉数 + 落库，支持按需只导某些表。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-245" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-246" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">4. dolphindb-hfdataimport 组：高频历史行情导入（国泰安 / 通联）</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-247" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-248" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">面向量化研究常用的<span id="w-e-text-249" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">高频历史行情文件</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-250" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">（快照、逐笔委托/成交、tick、委托队列）：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-251" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-252" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">dolphindb-csmar-import：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-253" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 导 CSMAR（国泰安）数据，支持 CSV/ZIP，自动算推荐并行度、提交后台任务；</span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-254" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-255" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">dolphindb-datayes-import：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-256" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 导通联（DataYes）数据，流程相同；</span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-257" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-258" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">dolphindb-hfdataimport-check-env：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-259" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 两者共用的前置检查，确认 zip 插件和 <span id="w-e-text-260" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">easy_csmar</span></code><span id="w-e-text-261" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> / <span id="w-e-text-262" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">easy_datayes</span></code><span id="w-e-text-263" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 模块就绪，缺失时自动修复。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-264" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-265" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-266" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你的高频数据文件是这两家供应商的格式时。文件在服务器上给个路径，其余交给技能。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-267" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-void="true">
<div class="w-e-textarea-divider"><hr></div>
<div data-slate-spacer="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<h2 id="w-e-element-269" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-270" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">三、算东西：回测、因子、定价、机器学习</span></span></span></h2>
<p id="w-e-element-271" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-272" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">这是 DolphinDB 的"主战场"，官方技能也最丰富。这些技能共同遵守一条铁律：<span id="w-e-text-273" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">生成结果必须真在平台上执行验证过才给你</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-274" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，不许凭记忆编代码。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-275" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-276" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">1. dolphindb-backtest-skill：量化策略回测</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-277" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-278" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-279" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 从你的策略描述直接<span id="w-e-text-280" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code class="token bold"><strong><span data-slate-string="true">生成、审查、修改完整的回测 .dos 脚本</span></strong></code><span id="w-e-text-281" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-282" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-283" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-284" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你说“双均线金叉买入、死叉卖出，按天调仓”，它生成完整可跑的回测脚本；它内置一套“不编造”约束，数据表、字段、接口都必须有据可查，查不到就明说并问你，<span id="w-e-text-285" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">产出可审计、可复核</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-286" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-287" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-288" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">2. dolphindb-daily-factor / dolphindb-highfreq-factor：因子生成（按数据频率分工）</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-289" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-290" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">两款技能的分工看<span id="w-e-text-291" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">源数据粒度</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-292" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，而不是输出：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-293" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-294" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">daily-factor：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-295" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 因子直接算在<span id="w-e-text-296" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">日K/日线</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-297" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">上（比如 20 日动量、PE 分位）；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-298" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">•<span id="w-e-text-299" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">highfreq-factor：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-300" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 因子从<span id="w-e-text-301" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">分钟/tick 高频</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-302" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">数据算起，再降频汇总到日频（比如日内振幅、买卖压力比）。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-303" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-304" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-305" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你把因子思路告诉 AI，它按模板生成因子函数 → 在平台上<span id="w-e-text-306" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">真实执行并返回结果</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-307" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">才交付给你，顺带把 <span id="w-e-text-308" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">\</span></code><span id="w-e-text-309" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 除法、复权、未来函数这类高频坑都处理掉。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-310" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-311" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">3. dolphindb-report-factor-replication：研报因子复现</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-312" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-313" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-314" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 把卖方研报里的因子<span id="w-e-text-315" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">复现成可运行的 DolphinDB 代码</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-316" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">的一条流水线。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-317" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-318" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-319" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 从"研报里读出一堆因子公式"到"代码能跑"之间隔着一堆脏活：提取候选因子 → 解析公式 → <span id="w-e-text-320" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">审计数据源字段够不够</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-321" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> → 决定用 MR 还是 Execute 跑 → 生成代码 → 检查有没有未来数据泄露。它把这些步骤全部规范化，<span id="w-e-text-322" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">防止把研报因子"复现"出一个对不上数据的假因子</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-323" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-324" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-325" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">4. dolphindb-ficc-pricing：FICC 定价</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-326" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-327" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-328" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 固定收益与衍生品定价规范，覆盖 <span id="w-e-text-329" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">13 类资产</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-330" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">：债券、存款、IRS 利率互换、外汇即期/远期/掉期/期权/NDF、商品期货期权、权益期权等。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-331" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-332" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-333" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你描述一笔债券条款或一张期权，它帮你正确构造 Instrument 和市场数据（利率曲线、波动率曲面等），选对定价函数（<span id="w-e-text-334" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">bondPricer</span></code><span id="w-e-text-335" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、<span id="w-e-text-336" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">fxForwardPricer</span></code><span id="w-e-text-337" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 或统一的 <span id="w-e-text-338" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">instrumentPricer</span></code><span id="w-e-text-339" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">）算出可审计的结果。<span id="w-e-text-340" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">对新手最有用的点：字段名不许瞎编</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-341" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">（比如债券用 <span id="w-e-text-342" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">start</span></code><span id="w-e-text-343" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 不是 <span id="w-e-text-344" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">issueDate</span></code><span id="w-e-text-345" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">），AI 会照着每类资产的字段说明来。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-346" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-347" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">5. dolphindb-machinelearning：机器学习数据工作流</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-348" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-349" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-350" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> Web 侧做 ML 的<span id="w-e-text-351" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">唯一入口</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-352" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，覆盖从选数、清洗、特征工程到分类/回归/聚类的完整流程。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-353" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-354" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-355" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你说“我想预测某股票下月是否上涨”，它引导 AI：发现数据 → 选建模数据 → 清洗 → 做特征 → 建模。过程中有两个<span id="w-e-text-356" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">强制确认点</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-357" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">：清洗完、特征做完了，必须先汇报方案和影响，等你确认再继续，避免 AI 自作主张把数据改坏。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-358" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-359" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">6. dolphindb-orca-dstream：Orca 声明式流计算</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-360" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-361" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-362" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 编写/审查/修复 <span id="w-e-text-363" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">Orca DStream</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-364" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 流计算脚本的技能（覆盖 source/sink、各类流引擎 timeSeries、reactiveState、lookupJoin 等）。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-365" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-366" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-367" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 实时行情处理这类需求，它能输出<span id="w-e-text-368" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">完整可直接运行的流图脚本</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-369" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">（含环境清理、mock 数据、结果查询），而不是半截代码。如果你不碰实时流计算，可以暂时忽略这款。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2 id="w-e-element-374" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-375" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">四、展示与维护：画图、排查故障、写测试</span></span></span></h2>
<h3 id="w-e-element-376" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-377" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">1. dolphindb-plot：图表可视化</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-378" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-379" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-380" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 把你的可视化需求转成 <span id="w-e-text-381" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><code><span data-slate-string="true">plot()</span></code><span id="w-e-text-382" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 调用。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-383" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-384" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-385" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 说一句"把最近 30 天成交额画成折线图，再加一条均线"，它生成代码并在环境支持时直接出图。支持折线、柱形、条形、饼图、面积、散点、三维曲面 7 类图；多量纲对比时自动处理双 Y 轴。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-386" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-387" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">2. dolphindb-ops：运维与故障排查</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-388" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-389" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-390" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> DolphinDB 运维脚本与知识库，覆盖 <span id="w-e-text-391" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">OOM、慢查询、流延迟、磁盘满、副本异常</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-392" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">等诊断，以及备份恢复、安全配置、作业管理。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-393" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-394" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-395" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 数据库出问题时你描述现象，它按“证据驱动”原则排查：<span id="w-e-text-396" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">不猜故障、每条结论给依据、涉及修复函数先给完整定义</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-397" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">。对新手最友好的一点：它不会装懂，查不到依据会明说“需要更多证据”。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="w-e-element-398" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-399" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">3. dolphindb-test：测试方案与用例生成</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-400" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-401" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-402" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 为函数、SQL、存储引擎、流引擎、插件<span id="w-e-text-403" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">自动生成测试方案和完整用例</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-404" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，内置 9000+ 篇官方文档作为依据。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-405" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-406" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-407" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 你改了公司内部函数或要验证某个 SQL 行为，说一声，它产出覆盖边界/异常/正常场景的测试用例，并严格保证“异常用例在前、正常在后、每条要点都有用例对应”。适合需要交付质量保障的团队场景。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-408" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-void="true">
<div class="w-e-textarea-divider"><hr></div>

<h2 id="w-e-element-410" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-411" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">五、一款特殊的技能：dolphindb-rag（防止 AI"瞎编"）</span></span></span></h2>
<h3 id="w-e-element-412" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-413" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">1. dolphindb-rag：回答纪律兜底</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="w-e-element-414" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-415" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">它是什么：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-416" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 不是帮你干活的技能，而是约束 AI <span id="w-e-text-417" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">"回答任何 DolphinDB 问题都必须有依据"</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-418" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 的纪律技能。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-419" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-420" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">有什么用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-421" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> DolphinDB 函数在不同版本里签名变化很大，AI 凭记忆很容易给出"听起来对、跑起来错"的答案。装了它之后，AI 只能基于这四种来源回答：官方文档、你本地给的材料、<span id="w-e-text-422" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">在平台上实际跑出来的结果</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-423" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">、捆绑的参考资料；查不到就明说"我不确定"，并标注未验证内容。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="w-e-element-424" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-425" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">什么时候用：</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-426" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true"> 不需要你主动触发，它在问答场景会自动兜底。<span id="w-e-text-427" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">对新手这是最有价值的一款</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-428" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，等于给你的 AI 助手加了一层“不知道就承认”的保险。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div id="w-e-element-429" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-void="true">
<div class="w-e-textarea-divider"><hr></div>
<div data-slate-spacer="true">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<h2 id="w-e-element-431" data-slate-node="element"><span id="w-e-text-432" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">新手怎么开始？（三步）</span></span></span></h2>
<div id="w-e-element-433" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">1.<span id="w-e-text-434" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">升级到 DolphinDB 3.00.6+</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-435" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，打开 Web 界面，进入“交互编程”页，创建一个 AI 会话并<span id="w-e-text-436" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">一键初始化</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-437" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，完成后 23 款内置技能就自动可用了；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-438" data-slate-node="element"><span data-w-e-reserve="true">2.<span id="w-e-text-439" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">直接提需求</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-440" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">，用大白话就行，比如“帮我把这个 CSV 导成按天分区的表”“写个双均线回测”“把这两列画成折线图”。AI 会自动挑对应的技能干活；</span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div id="w-e-element-441" data-slate-node="element" data-slate-fragment=""><span data-w-e-reserve="true">3.<span id="w-e-text-442" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><strong class="token bold"><span data-slate-string="true">发现它"不干活"时别慌</span></strong><span id="w-e-text-443" data-slate-node="text"><span data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">：技能是按需加载的，AI 会先判断要不要用；涉及删数据、覆盖表这类操作时，技能会先停下来问你，确认后才执行。</span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<p id="w-e-element-444" data-slate-node="element">&nbsp;</p>
